remarks: This move-in-ready home combines style, comfort, and exceptional indoor-outdoor living in one of Norwalk's most convenient locations. From its inviting curb appeal to its thoughtfully designed updates, the property is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Inside, the updated kitchen, hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, and wood-burning fireplace create a warm and polished atmosphere throughout the main level. Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full baths, the home offers a functional layout with flexibility and comfort for a variety of lifestyles. The dining area flows seamlessly onto an elevated deck, providing the perfect setting for relaxing or hosting guests. Beneath the deck, a finished storage area with barn-door access offers practical space for tools, equipment, and easy backyard maintenance. An attached garage leads directly into the finished lower level, complete with sliding doors that open to a spacious patio and fully fenced backyard. Ideally situated near Westport Avenue shopping, vibrant SoNo dining and nightlife, and Calf Pasture Beach. This home also offers easy commuter access I95 and the East Norwalk train station. A rare opportunity to enjoy value, convenience, and lifestyle in a sought-after neighborhood.
